name: cmd-line-mcp
description: A secure Model Context Protocol server that allows AI assistants to execute terminal commands with controlled directory access and command permissions. It features a robust security architecture including whitelisting, session IDs, and categorized command levels to ensure safe system interaction.

rawRecord.description: A secure Model Context Protocol server that allows AI assistants to execute terminal commands with controlled directory access and command permissions. It features a robust security architecture including whitelisting, session IDs, and categorized command levels to ensure safe system interaction.

CMD_LINE_MCP_CONFIG.description: Path to a custom configuration JSON file.

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_READ.description: Comma-separated list of allowed read commands (e.g., awk,jq,wc).

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_WRITE.description: Comma-separated list of allowed write commands.

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_SYSTEM.description: Comma-separated list of allowed system commands.

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_REQUIRE_SESSION_ID.description: Whether to require a session ID for operations (true/false). Defaults to false.

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_ALLOW_COMMAND_SEPA.description: Whether to allow command separators like ; or && (true/false).

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_AUTO_APPROVE_DIREC.description: Whether to auto-approve directories when running in desktop mode (true/false).
